summary: Executed Phase59 duplicate-audit verification on public preview (backend + frontend), including requested regressions (Phase57/55/38) and auth playbook checks.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Royalty Import -> Audit File Ganda -> Mulai Audit File Ganda
integration_issues.issue: On live UI run, panel stayed in loading state ('Memeriksa…') for >60s without rendering progress/summary/empty state, despite preview endpoint responding 200.

action_items: Investigate why duplicate-audit panel can remain in busy/loading state without progress/result rendering on live UI despite successful preview POST.
Verify frontend poll loop for /api/royalty/admin/duplicate-audit/jobs/{job_id} is always invoked and reflected in UI state during long-running jobs.
Optionally add client-side timeout/fallback message when audit polling exceeds expected duration.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend duplicate-audit route correctly remains read-only and excludes Mongo _id from job/rows payloads.
Fingerprint and grouping logic matches requested strong signal (total lines, EUR total, period range, exact period breakdown).
Import list and duplicate-audit controls include dedicated data-testid attributes for new interactive elements.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 passed across targeted Phase59+regression+auth+live smoke suites)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (core royalty-import/audit panel render and trigger passed; audit completion UI did not finalize within observation window)

seed_data_creation: No seed scripts executed in this iteration; tests used existing environment data and temporary test records from executed suites.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI smoke used superadmin on public preview URL. Duplicate audit panel opens and start action fires, but in this run remained in loading state >60s with no rendered progress/result. Backend targeted tests for Phase59 and regression suites still pass.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: login -> /admin/royalty -> open Audit File Ganda -> click Mulai Audit File Ganda. Observed button switches to loading text, but no progress/summary/empty-state appears during wait window. Backend logs show preview POST 200; separate API smoke confirms jobs/rows endpoints are reachable and ObjectId-safe. Likely UI polling/state-sync gap (poll invocation, response handling, or long-running-job UX fallback) rather than backend route failure.
